name: Yae
source:
A demon who works together with Souma. he suddenly appears in front of Mahora and forces him to give Shuu back. He appears to think in terms of pros and cons, but no one truly knows anything about him.

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
